purpose: Frozen bounded test-review cases; evaluate independently without changing external projects. Derived controls are explicitly labelled, not production observations.

cases.task: Review the value of these assertions for a no-external-CDN property. No separate byte-size requirement is supplied. Avoid assuming this excerpt is the whole user contract.
cases.evidence: The test reads local favicon.svg and expects (svgBytes / 1024).toFixed(1) === '94.8', expects favicon.png length === 103, and requires the specification to repeat '94.8 KB' and '103 B'. Nearby checks verify local origins. Optimizing the same self-hosted SVG can change its size without adding a remote request.

cases.kind: observed GLLA source and recorded failure
cases.task: Review this workflow test. The intended requirement is that push churn cannot cancel release publication, with release gates preserved.
cases.evidence: A test rejects /newest QUEUED/i and /even with cancel-in-progress:false/i in the run-level workflow text, and requires /ONE running and ONE pending/i. An explanatory correction quoted the obsolete wording and failed despite unchanged workflow configuration. Other tests check the event-specific concurrency expression and publish gates.

cases.kind: observed external trace; bounded historical evidence
cases.source: Hegemon session 2026-10-17 16:40-16:47 UTC; parent trace investigation recorded in conversation; source reference also in audit/VERIFICATION-ROI-AND-WAIT-PRESENTATION-PLAN-2026-10-18.md E2
cases.task: Assess whether updating these expected totals alone is substantive regression coverage. No user requirement to publish exact test totals is provided.
cases.evidence: A full run reported 10,984 pass / 12 fail, with listed failures concerning published test totals/documentation consistency. The agent refreshed counts across documents and assertions. Another run reported 11,234 pass / 1 fail, followed by changing an expected assertion-call total from 45,624 to 114,582. These observations do not establish that every failure or every test run was wasteful.

cases.kind: observed external source; useful static control
cases.task: Assess whether exact/static assertions should be removed here.
cases.evidence: The no-external-CDN checks reject a remote kit.paths.assets origin and require the app favicon to use the SvelteKit assets placeholder. Repointing assets to a CDN would cause remote requests even if filenames and local files remained unchanged. Formatting robustness of the regex is a separate concern from the value of the origin boundary.

cases.kind: observed GLLA source; useful exact/configuration control
cases.task: Assess the value of protecting event-specific release cancellation, provenance and OIDC permissions; do not claim a local test proves GitHub execution.
cases.evidence: The release run uses event-specific cancellation and an independent publish lane with cancel-in-progress false. Tests require the release-only publish condition, npm run release:check, tag/package-version matching, npm publish --provenance --access public, and id-token: write. Removing a gate or allowing push churn to cancel publication changes the release contract.

cases.task: Assess whether this verification should be skipped as unproductive waiting.
cases.evidence: The user's contract required observing an hourly backup. The executor scheduled a wait until 22:30 UTC, resumed at 22:31 and inspected backup attempts before claiming completion. The wait and observation protect an explicit live-infrastructure requirement; this trace is not a proof of all wake reliability.

cases.kind: derived counterfactual control, not an observed project requirement
cases.task: Assess an exact byte check when the confirmed contract explicitly requires distributing a legacy binary fixture byte-for-byte for consumer compatibility.
cases.evidence: Changing even one byte breaks an externally specified compatibility fixture. A hash/byte equality assertion protects that explicit contract; there is no permission to replace it with a loose size range or file-exists check.

cases.kind: derived ambiguity control, not an observed project requirement
cases.task: An old test requires an exported table to contain exactly four entries. The call sites and original contract have not yet been inspected. Decide the safe disposition from this evidence alone.
cases.evidence: Four may be an accidental inventory fact or a protocol enum consumed by another system. No evidence distinguishes them. A broad instruction to delete count assertions would risk weakening a real contract.
